releases.title: Domain Contracts, Remediation FSM, Public Packs & Cloud Workflows Schemas
releases.summary: Established strict incident triage contracts, illegal-states-unrepresentable remediation & saga FSM, adversarial log-injection sanitizer, deterministic O(C+R) citation verifier, BigQuery & Cloud Workflows schemas, and 3 real-public-first industry packs (SecOps SIEM, Supply Chain O2C, Cloud SRE).
highlights: 15 curated multi-domain incident scenarios grounded in live MITRE ATT&CK STIX, CISA KEV, NOAA NWS Alerts, UN/LOCODE, Google Cloud Status, and OpenTelemetry conventions
Deterministic log prompt-injection quarantine and two-click lead approval state machine preventing autonomous production mutations
Atomic Cloud Workflows YAML sagas with automatic WMS compensation rollback on downstream carrier failure
